item.title: Buckmister Fuller Dome at LongHouse Collapsed Under Snow
item.description: LongHouse Reserve in East Hampton announced Friday that visionary architect and futurist Buckminster Fuller’s “Fly’s Eye Dome” sculpture has collapsed due to the weight of heavy snow combined with sustained freezing temperatures.
